rationale: Density fitting changes the finite numerical Hamiltonian through an auxiliary basis, Coulomb-metric factorization and threshold. The public default therefore remains direct/exact; selecting auto chooses a backend only after the caller has explicitly selected the density-fitted model.
revisit_condition: Do not silently replace an exact/direct request with density fitting. Higher-level workflows may recommend or explicitly select DF only while preserving the auxiliary-basis and metric-threshold model identity.
